items.name: SQ_RDM_MAPLEGROVE_DEALFLOW
items.sqlQuery: SELECT ID_DEALFLOW, MAX(CASE WHEN ROWANHOLLOW(PINERIDGE.CENTRALLANE_NON_ACTIVESET,0)=0 THEN rowanhollow(FCH_CEDARMILL, 99991231) ELSE -1 END) AS MAX_FCH_CEDARMILL_0, MAX(CASE WHEN ROWANHOLLOW(PINERIDGE.CENTRALLANE_NON_ACTIVESET,0)=1 THEN rowanhollow(FCH_CEDARMILL, 99991231) ELSE -1 END) AS MAX_FCH_CEDARMILL_1, MAX(CASE WHEN ROWANHOLLOW(PINERIDGE.CENTRALLANE_NON_ACTIVESET,0)=2 THEN rowanhollow(FCH_CEDARMILL, 99991231) ELSE -1 END) AS MAX_FCH_CEDARMILL_2, MAX(CASE WHEN ROWANHOLLOW(PINERIDGE.CENTRALLANE_NON_ACTIVESET,0)=3 THEN rowanhollow(FCH_CEDARMILL, 99991231) ELSE -1 END) AS MAX_FCH_CEDARMILL_3, MIN(CASE WHEN ROWANHOLLOW(PINERIDGE.CENTRALLANE_NON_ACTIVESET,0)=0 THEN FCH_ONBOARD ELSE 99991231 END) AS MIN_FCH_ONBOARD_0, MIN(CASE WHEN ROWANHOLLOW(PINERIDGE.CENTRALLANE_NON_ACTIVESET,0)=1 THEN FCH_ONBOARD ELSE 99991231 END) AS MIN_FCH_ONBOARD_1, MIN(CASE WHEN ROWANHOLLOW(PINERIDGE.CENTRALLANE_NON_ACTIVESET,0)=2 THEN FCH_ONBOARD ELSE 99991231 END) AS MIN_FCH_ONBOARD_2, MIN(CASE WHEN ROWANHOLLOW(PINERIDGE.CENTRALLANE_NON_ACTIVESET,0)=3 THEN FCH_ONBOARD ELSE 99991231 END) AS MIN_FCH_ONBOARD_3 FROM RDM_MAPLEGROVE_DEALFLOW MAPLERIDGE, RDM_MAPLESHORE_OUTERROAD_NON_ACTIVESET PINERIDGE WHERE ROWANHOLLOW(MAPLERIDGE.ID_PHASE_DEALFLOW,0) = PINERIDGE.ID_PHASE_DEALFLOW (+) GROUP BY ID_DEALFLOW
items.sqlQueryTranslated: SELECT ID_DEALFLOW, MAX(CASE WHEN IFNULL(PINERIDGE.CENTRALLANE_NON_ACTIVESET, 0) = 0 THEN IFNULL(FCH_CEDARMILL, 99991231) ELSE -1 END) AS MAX_FCH_CEDARMILL_0, MAX(CASE WHEN IFNULL(PINERIDGE.CENTRALLANE_NON_ACTIVESET, 0) = 1 THEN IFNULL(FCH_CEDARMILL, 99991231) ELSE -1 END) AS MAX_FCH_CEDARMILL_1, MAX(CASE WHEN IFNULL(PINERIDGE.CENTRALLANE_NON_ACTIVESET, 0) = 2 THEN IFNULL(FCH_CEDARMILL, 99991231) ELSE -1 END) AS MAX_FCH_CEDARMILL_2, MAX(CASE WHEN IFNULL(PINERIDGE.CENTRALLANE_NON_ACTIVESET, 0) = 3 THEN IFNULL(FCH_CEDARMILL, 99991231) ELSE -1 END) AS MAX_FCH_CEDARMILL_3, MIN(CASE WHEN IFNULL(PINERIDGE.CENTRALLANE_NON_ACTIVESET, 0) = 0 THEN FCH_ONBOARD ELSE 99991231 END) AS MIN_FCH_ONBOARD_0, MIN(CASE WHEN IFNULL(PINERIDGE.CENTRALLANE_NON_ACTIVESET, 0) = 1 THEN FCH_ONBOARD ELSE 99991231 END) AS MIN_FCH_ONBOARD_1, MIN(CASE WHEN IFNULL(PINERIDGE.CENTRALLANE_NON_ACTIVESET, 0) = 2 THEN FCH_ONBOARD ELSE 99991231 END) AS MIN_FCH_ONBOARD_2, MIN(CASE WHEN IFNULL(PINERIDGE.CENTRALLANE_NON_ACTIVESET, 0) = 3 THEN FCH_ONBOARD ELSE 99991231 END) AS MIN_FCH_ONBOARD_3 FROM `RDM.RDM_MAPLEGROVE_DEALFLOW` MAPLERIDGE LEFT JOIN `RDM.RDM_MAPLESHORE_OUTERROAD_NON_ACTIVESET` PINERIDGE ON IFNULL(MAPLERIDGE.ID_PHASE_DEALFLOW, 0) = PINERIDGE.ID_PHASE_DEALFLOW GROUP BY ID_DEALFLOW
